_comment: Exceptions to the rules in scripts/build-model-guidance.mjs. Each entry: role (fast, default, deep, frontier), effort, and why. Rerun the generator after editing.

chart-data-extractor.why: Reads values off chart pixels; the skill's own requirements section asks for the strongest vision model available.

pptx-slide-auditor.why: Audits rendered slides as images; small text and alignment need the stronger vision model.

docx-tracked-changes.why: Edits a contract-style document change by change; a dropped change is hard to see afterwards.
